pinned_d1_source.behavior: Rise of Iron TransformVertexColors appends RGBA=(0,0,0,GroupIndex/15) as an exporter-side helper for dyemap assignment.

conflicting_later_source.behavior: Later D2-oriented TransformVertexColors uses GroupIndex%4 -> R/G/B/white. The current file no longer carries D1 SMapTerrainResource/STerrain SchemaStruct declarations.

correction.invalid_for_d1: GroupIndex%4 R/G/B/white must not be cited as D1 Rise of Iron terrain semantics.
correction.retained_d1_helper: RGBA=(0,0,0,GroupIndex/15) may be retained only as the pinned D1 exporter-side helper.
correction.native_gpu_boundary: Neither helper is promoted as the retail D1 GPU source attribute without an independent producer/consumer proof from the native terrain VS/input assembler.

unaffected_core_evidence: T14 absence from serialized material texture arrays and native shader T14 use
